headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds defeated the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2, with Chase Burns earning the win, and Jose Trevino leading the Reds' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 10-run victory, and the Cleveland Guardians edged the Chicago White Sox 6-5 in a thrilling finish.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, including Jason Adam, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the San Diego Padres due to a right shoulder strain. The Washington Nationals have also been affected, with Mitchell Parker being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. Other teams have also reported injuries, including the San Francisco Giants, Kansas City Royals, Texas Rangers, Detroit Tigers, and Boston Red Sox.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-hander Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. Other trades and roster movements include the Athletics trading 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen, and the Texas Rangers trading C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Chase Burns earning the win. Jose Trevino led the Reds' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Rout Marlins 14-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 10-run victory. Jake McCarthy led the Rockies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Tim Herrin earning the win. Brayan Rocchio led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres' Jason Adam Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres right-handed pitcher Jason Adam has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain, effective retroactive to June 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-hander Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.
